description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity named AudioFxDemo that demonstrates the use of audio effects such as Visualizer and Equalizer on a MediaPlayer object. It sets up UI components to display audio visualization and controls for equalizer bands, and manages audio playback, visualizer, and effects lifecycle.

classes.name: AudioFxDemo
classes.description: Main activity that initializes media playback with audio effects and visualizer UI.

classes.name: VisualizerView
classes.description: Custom View class that visualizes audio waveform data received from the Visualizer.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up media player, visualizer, and equalizer.

methods.name: setupEqualizerFxAndUI
methods.description: Sets up the equalizer effects and UI sliders for each frequency band.

methods.name: setupVisualizerFxAndUI
methods.description: Creates and configures the visualizer for audio waveform visualization.

methods.name: updateVisualizer
methods.description: Updates the visualizer view with new waveform data.
